46: /-- (Implementation): Bilinear map for defining `TensorProduct.piRightHom`. -/
47: def piRightHomBil : N →ₗ[S] (∀ i, M i) →ₗ[R] ∀ i, N ⊗[R] M i where
48:   toFun n := LinearMap.pi (fun i ↦ mk R N (M i) n ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj i)

54: /-- For any `R`-module `N`, index type `ι` and family of `R`-modules `Mᵢ`, there is a natural
55: linear map `N ⊗[R] (∀ i, M i) →ₗ ∀ i, N ⊗[R] M i`. This map is an isomorphism if `ι` is finite. -/
56: def piRightHom : N ⊗[R] (∀ i, M i) →ₗ[S] ∀ i, N ⊗[R] M i :=
57:   AlgebraTensorModule.lift <| piRightHomBil R S N M

60: lemma piRightHom_tmul (x : N) (f : ∀ i, M i) :
61:     piRightHom R S N M (x ⊗ₜ f) = (fun j ↦ x ⊗ₜ f j) :=
62:   rfl

66: /-- (Implementation): Inverse for `TensorProduct.piRight`. -/
67: def piRightInv : (∀ i, N ⊗[R] M i) →ₗ[S] N ⊗[R] ∀ i, M i :=
68:   LinearMap.lsum S (fun i ↦ N ⊗[R] M i) S <| fun i ↦
69:     AlgebraTensorModule.map LinearMap.id (single R M i)
70: 
71: @[simp]
72: private lemma piRightInv_apply (x : N) (m : ∀ i, M i) :
73:     piRightInv R S N M (fun i ↦ x ⊗ₜ m i) = x ⊗ₜ m := by
74:   simp only [piRightInv, lsum_apply, coe_sum, coe_comp, coe_proj, Finset.sum_apply,
75:     Function.comp_apply, Function.eval, AlgebraTensorModule.map_tmul, id_coe, id_eq, coe_single]
76:   rw [← tmul_sum]
77:   congr
78:   ext j
79:   simp
80: 
81: @[simp]
82: private lemma piRightInv_single (x : N) (i : ι) (m : M i) :
83:     piRightInv R S N M (Pi.single i (x ⊗ₜ m)) = x ⊗ₜ Pi.single i m := by
84:   have : Pi.single i (x ⊗ₜ m) = fun j ↦ x ⊗ₜ[R] (Pi.single i m j) := by
85:     ext j
86:     rw [← tmul_single]
87:   rw [this]
88:   simp

90: /-- Tensor product commutes with finite products on the right. -/
91: def piRight : N ⊗[R] (∀ i, M i) ≃ₗ[S] ∀ i, N ⊗[R] M i :=
92:   LinearEquiv.ofLinear
93:     (piRightHom R S N M)
94:     (piRightInv R S N M)
95:     (by ext i x m j; simp [tmul_single])
96:     (by ext x j m; simp)
97: 
98: @[simp]
99: lemma piRight_apply (x : N ⊗[R] (∀ i, M i)) :
100:     piRight R S N M x = piRightHom R S N M x := by
101:   rfl

103: @[simp]
104: lemma piRight_symm_apply (x : N) (m : ∀ i, M i) :
105:     (piRight R S N M).symm (fun i ↦ x ⊗ₜ m i) = x ⊗ₜ m := by
106:   simp [piRight]

109: lemma piRight_symm_single (x : N) (i : ι) (m : M i) :
110:     (piRight R S N M).symm (Pi.single i (x ⊗ₜ m)) = x ⊗ₜ Pi.single i m := by

661:   AlgebraTensorModule.map (LinearMap.id : A →ₗ[A] A) f
